message.content: On September 16th, 2026, WolfgangSchulz suggested incorporating improvisational solos into their practice sessions. This idea was met with enthusiasm by LiHua, who believed it would boost their jazz fusion skills, make sessions more fun and creative, and provide an opportunity to see what each musician brings to the table. The team agreed to try this new approach during their regular Sunday night practices, with WolfgangSchulz stating, "Going with the flow sounds perfect! We can just vibe off each other and see where it takes us. It's all about having fun, right?" LiHua added, "Absolutely! I love the idea of jamming without a strict plan. It'll keep things spontaneous and exciting!"
